name: A11yKit Accessibility
author: Md. Shahinur Islam

sections.description:
A11yKit Accessibility is a comprehensive accessibility solution designed to enhance usability and ensure compliance with WCAG 2.1 standards — without requiring any theme modifications.

Built for developers, agencies, and site owners, A11yKit makes it easy to create inclusive, user-friendly websites that are accessible to everyone, including users with disabilities.

🚀 Upgrade to PRO:
Unlock advanced features and premium support:
👉 https://mdshahinurislamm.github.io/wp-accessibility-suite/

🎯 Why choose A11yKit?
– Improve accessibility instantly
– No coding required
– Lightweight and performance-friendly
– Fully customizable
– Works with any WordPress theme

Features

🎛️ Floating Accessibility Toolbar

  • Flexible positioning (top/bottom, left/right)
  • Custom color schemes
  • Enable/disable individual tools

🔗 Skip Navigation Links

  • Skip to content, navigation, and footer
  • Customizable labels
  • Focus-only or always-visible options

🎯 Focus Management

  • Custom focus styles (color, width, type)
  • Prevents removal of focus outlines for better keyboard navigation

🔠 Font Resizer

  • Increase, decrease, and reset font sizes
  • Configurable limits and step values
  • User preferences saved locally

🎨 Contrast & Color Modes

  • High Contrast Mode
  • Dark Mode
  • Grayscale Mode
  • Inverted Colors

🔍 Link Accessibility Enhancements

  • Highlight and underline links
  • External link indicators (↗ icon with ARIA support)
  • Screen reader-friendly new tab warnings
  • Improved “Read More” link descriptions

🖼️ Image Accessibility Tools

  • Detect missing ALT attributes in admin
  • Enforce proper use of decorative image ALT tags

⌨️ Keyboard Navigation Support

  • Improved menu navigation using arrow keys
  • Automatic tabindex corrections

🧭 ARIA & Landmark Support

  • Automatic landmark roles (main, navigation, footer)
  • Page load announcements for screen readers
  • Table accessibility improvements (scope attributes)

📖 Reading & Dyslexia Tools

  • Reading guide (focus line)
  • Dyslexia-friendly font (OpenDyslexic via CDN)
  • Large cursor option

🎞️ Motion Control

  • Reduce motion mode (disables animations and transitions)

🛠️ Admin Accessibility Checks

  • Heading structure analysis
  • Missing ALT text alerts

🎥 Demo Video:
https://youtu.be/-W6YllQrS4M
sections.installation:
1. Upload the a11ykit-accessibility folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Navigate to Settings → A11yKit Accessibility to configure options.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require coding knowledge?

No. A11yKit is designed to work out-of-the-box with simple configuration options.

Will it work with my theme?

Yes. It is compatible with most WordPress themes without modification.

What additional features are available in PRO?

The PRO version includes advanced customization options, enhanced accessibility tools, priority support, and ongoing feature updates.
👉 Learn more: https://mdshahinurislamm.github.io/wp-accessibility-suite/

Does it guarantee full WCAG compliance?

A11yKit significantly improves accessibility, but full compliance may require additional content and design considerations.
